title: MRF-D 25.3: VMM-363 conducts MV-22B hoist drills aboard the USS Miguel Keith
description: U.S. Marines with Marine Medium Tiltrotor Squadron (VMM) 363, Marine Rotational Force – Darwin 25.3, conduct hoist drills out of an MV-22B Osprey aboard the expeditionary sea base USS Miguel Keith (ESB 5) in the Philippine Sea, Sept. 4, 2025. For the first time in the rotation’s history, the MRF-D Marine Air-Ground Task Force's Aviation and Ground Combat Elements embarked aboard a U.S. Navy vessel to extend operational reach and provide flexible, combat-credible options across the Indo-Pacific. MRF-D is an annual six-month rotational deployment to enhance interoperability with the Australian Defence Force and allies and partners and provide a forward postured crisis response force in the Indo-Pacific. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Cpl. Angelina Sara)
keywords: joint force, MV-22B, USS Miguel Keith, MRF-D 25.3, U.S. Navy, interoperability
